description: This Java source file defines the 'EnterpriseApplication' class, which bootstraps an embedded Jetty server configured with Spring MVC to serve REST endpoints in a standalone mode. It programmatically sets up the server, context handlers, and servlet configuration, making it a main application entry point for a Spring-based web service running on a customizable port.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class that starts an embedded Jetty server with Spring MVC configuration, acting as the application entry point.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main method initializes and starts the embedded Jetty server, configures Spring contexts, sets up servlets, and manages shutdown hooks.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves the server port from system properties '-Dport' or '-Dserver.port', defaulting to 3001 if none are specified.
